title: Hard to chop a cut up Onion ,but chopped good, handle kept popping off, Cheesy.
text:
Hard to chop a cut up Onion ,but chopped good, handle kept popping off, Cheesy.. I thought this would be great to have to put in a motorhome Rv, Use for camping ,
Or if electricity went out in the winter in the mountains in Ca, which happens.
I use almost everyday a 4 cup Glass electric chopper from Amazon, and actually I have two In case one goes out, it has happened before, but there easy to use, clean, and
Under $20.00.

This Olyia comes with a plastic bowl, that is not thick and bends abit. a Handle to fit on the bowl that kept popping Off , finally didn’t use it, when trying to hold the bowl from moving around when using the blades to chop up a med size onion that I cut up first but was not easy to do in this, although at the End it did chop the onion good.

On the lid is a hole to add olive oil etc, but holds a egg separator To use or keep on
All the time. I noticed it popped off when using this to chop.

I have to say after my Bad Experience trying to chop a onion, and hold this together
In my arms for dear life that it wouldn’t jump away, I didn’t try the plastic egg Beaters
On this so I can’t say how it works, although I would use a bowl and fork, or my
Spring Egg scrambler from Amazon. Too big of a deal to hand wash all this for scrambled eggs.

The blades are sharp, but cheap. Actually this whole food processor is cheesy.
I do not know what this will sell for, but I would put a price on it for about $10.95.
Or less !
Giving a 2 star for a good idea.

product_metadata.title: OLIYA hand-cranked food processor/manual food chopper/meat grinder/cutter cooker and chopper/fruit blender and egg separator 3.2 cups/800ml
